items.title: Will Earnings Beat Change Newmont Stock Narrative
items.summary: Newmont Corporation reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$6,363 million and net income of US$2,475 million, alongside updated production guidance and a declared US$0.26 quarterly dividend. The combination of stronger profitability, lower cost guidance and reaffirmed gold output targets highlights how Newmont is working to tighten its operating discipline while still returning cash to shareholders. We will now look at how Newmont's stronger third quarter earnings and lower cost guidance...

items.title: Agnico Eagle Soars 10%, Wheaton Precious Up 12% as Democratic Midterm Win Lifts Gold
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAgnico Eagle jumped 10% today, along with Wheaton Precious Metals, Newmont and Barrick Mining, as gold climbed 3% after the Democrats’ midterm win. At Agnico’s third-quarter costs, a 3% rise in gold adds about 5% to its margin per ounce, which is half the stock’s gain.

items.title: Gold Mining Shares Rally as Democratic Midterm Victory Weakens US Dollar and Lifts Bullion Prices
items.summary: US-listed gold mining stocks advanced sharply in premarket trading on Wednesday as gold prices climbed following the Democratic Party’s victory in both chambers of Congress during the US midterm elections. Spot gold rose 3.
